(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A method for selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising: accessing a first server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on a second server computer; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, wherein the first server computer is a Web application server.

(Currently Amended) Claim 24: A system for selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, the system comprising: a first server computer; a second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature; circuitry for accessing the first server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; circuitry for adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer; and circuitry for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

(Currently Amended) Claim 27: A computer program product for selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, the computer program product comprising: a computer-readable medium having program instructions stored thereon that, when executed by a processor, cause the processor to perform the steps of: accessing a first server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on a second server computer; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, wherein the first server computer is a Web application server.
